product.title: Todos Santos Day Trip from Cabo San Lucas

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this small-group day follows the Pacific coast to Todos Santos for galleries, a blanket workshop, a pearl demonstration, and lunch at the Hotel California. A tequila tasting and a stop at the old Jesuit mission are on the published list, with hotel pickup and drop-off included so the group can stay with the town rather than self-driving the highway. Numbers are limited for a more personal pace. The format suits visitors who want a guided pueblo day without coordinating restaurant, tasting-room, and artisan timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on Todos Santos, the Hotel California, and the mission that define this Baja town outing rather than a La Paz beach add-on.

highlights: Visit Todos Santos, a community of thriving artisans, on this day trip from Los Cabos
Travel along the Pacific Coast to the eclectic little town situated near the southern tip of the Baja Peninsula
You’ll stop by a variety of art galleries and shops, enjoy a tequila tasting, and sit down for lunch at the Hotel Califo
